metadata.title: InspiraDB - AI-Powered Local Image Management for Mac
metadata.description: Organize 50,000+ images with AI auto-tagging and semantic search. 100% offline, privacy-first. Cloud BigBrain learns, Local SmallBrain responds in milliseconds.

hero.title: Your Images,
hero.subtitle: Organize 50,000+ photos with semantic search & AI auto-tagging. 100% offline. Your data never leaves your Mac.

features.title: Why Designers Choose InspiraDB
features.subtitle: Five powerful capabilities that transform how you manage visual assets

aiTagging.title: AI Auto-Tagging
aiTagging.description: Upload images and watch as AI automatically identifies content, generating precise Chinese tags organized by industry use, composition, and mood.

semanticSearch.title: Semantic Search
semanticSearch.description: Search by intention, not keywords. 'Blue tech product hero shot' finds exactly what you mean, not just files with those words.

offline.title: 100% Offline
offline.description: No internet required. Lightning-fast response times. Works on airplanes, in remote locations, anywhere you create.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: Your images stay on your Mac. Indexed database is locally encrypted. Zero data transmission. Complete commercial confidentiality.

hybrid.title: BigBrain + SmallBrain
hybrid.description: Cloud BigBrain continuously learns and evolves your tag system. Local SmallBrain delivers millisecond vector search. Best of both worlds.

step1.title: Import
step1.description: Drag folders or single images. We support JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC up to 50MB.

step2.title: AI Analysis
step2.description: Cloud BigBrain analyzes visuals, generates Chinese captions and tags. Local SmallBrain creates vector embeddings.

step3.title: Search & Find
step3.description: Type what you need in Chinese. Semantic search finds matches in milliseconds. Filter by tags to narrow results.

designer.title: UI/UX Designers
designer.description: Find that 'minimalist login page from last year' in seconds. Build mood boards without folder hell.

photographer.title: Photographers
photographer.description: 500,000 photos organized by style, lighting, and subject. Client asks for 'similar to this' — find matches instantly.

creator.title: Content Creators
creator.description: Never lose a thumbnail idea again. Search 'bold typography red background' and get exactly that.
